stories.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend

en.title: Here's the biggest news you missed this weekend
en.summary: An unidentified projectile hit Saudi Arabia's main international airport on Sunday, causing injuries. This occurred after a deadly missile attack at the same airport the previous day.

stories.title: Trump announces Russia-Ukraine "energy ceasefire" after criticizing Zelenskyy

en.title: Trump announces Russia-Ukraine "energy ceasefire" after criticizing Zelenskyy
en.summary: President Trump announced a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy responded by stating Russia bears sole responsibility for the war, following Trump's criticism of him.

stories.title: Terminal in Riyadh airport hit again, a day after deadly strike killed 12

en.title: Terminal in Riyadh airport hit again, a day after deadly strike killed 12
en.summary: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was struck again in an escalation of the conflict between Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia, following a previous attack that resulted in twelve deaths.

stories.title: Russia strikes power plant in Ukraine after Trump announces energy ceasefire

en.title: Russia strikes power plant in Ukraine after Trump announces energy ceasefire
en.summary: A Ukrainian thermal power plant was struck at least twice, according to Ukrainian officials, following Trump's announcement of an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine.

stories.title: Ukraine Shrugs Off Trump Call to Ditch Zelensky for Energy Strikes

en.title: Ukraine Shrugs Off Trump Call to Ditch Zelensky for Energy Strikes
en.summary: President Trump criticized President Zelensky's strikes on Russian oil refineries, while Zelensky stated he would cease such operations if Russia reciprocated.

stories.title: What to know about Pope Leo’s lung surgery

en.title: What to know about Pope Leo's lung surgery
en.summary: Pope Leo underwent lung surgery. Details about the procedure are available.

stories.title: Trump claims Russia and Ukraine agree to energy ceasefire, but Zelenskyy says that’s ‘news for me’

en.title: Trump claims Russia and Ukraine agree to energy ceasefire, but Zelenskyy says that's 'news for me'
en.summary: Trump announced an energy ceasefire agreement between Russia and Ukraine, though Zelenskyy suggested he was unaware of such an agreement. Trump made a similar announcement a month earlier.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week

en.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV will undergo surgery this week after doctors identified a localized nodule in his lung during examination.

stories.title: Pope Leo to undergo surgery after nodular lesion found in lung, Vatican says

en.title: Pope Leo to undergo surgery after nodular lesion found in lung, Vatican says
en.summary: Pope Leo will undergo surgery to address a nodular lesion discovered in his lung. The pontiff has no previously documented health issues and maintains an active lifestyle.

stories.title: Pope Leo says he will undergo surgery to remove a nodule on his lung

en.title: Pope Leo says he will undergo surgery to remove a nodule on his lung
en.summary: The 71-year-old pope will undergo surgery this week after medical examinations detected an early-stage nodule on his lung.

stories.title: Saudi airport struck again a day after deadly attack

en.title: Saudi airport struck again a day after deadly attack
en.summary: A projectile hit a terminal at Riyadh airport on Sunday, following a missile attack the previous day that killed 13 people and injured 309.

stories.title: Passenger terminal at Riyadh airport is struck again, a day after 12 were killed

en.title: Passenger terminal at Riyadh airport is struck again, a day after 12 were killed
en.summary: A projectile struck a passenger terminal at Riyadh's international airport on Sunday, one day after a missile attack on the same terminal killed 12 people.

stories.title: When Companies Stop Driving a Hard Bargain, This Fed Official Starts Worrying

en.title: When Companies Stop Driving a Hard Bargain, This Fed Official Starts Worrying
en.summary: Federal Reserve official Beth Hammack expressed concern that strong business pricing power and economic resilience suggest current interest rates remain insufficient to control inflation.

stories.title: Home Sellers Are Starting to Blink on Prices. That’s Bad for Builders.

en.title: Home Sellers Are Starting to Blink on Prices. That's Bad for Builders.
en.summary: Increased buyer competition is forcing major homebuilders like Lennar and KB Home to offer more incentives to attract purchasers.

stories.title: Why Economists Think Higher Bond Yields Are Here to Stay

en.title: Why Economists Think Higher Bond Yields Are Here to Stay
en.summary: A Wall Street Journal survey indicates economists expect bond yields to remain elevated due to persistent inflation, Federal Reserve actions, and government debt levels.

stories.title: The Sleepy Insurance Product That Came to Power Private Credit’s Ascent

en.title: The Sleepy Insurance Product That Came to Power Private Credit's Ascent
en.summary: Indexed annuities, which protect investors from market losses while allowing insurers to adjust return formulas, have played a key role in the growth of private credit markets.
